children: Mayora Indah could face headwinds from a challenging Philippine export market, CGS International analysts say in a note. The Indonesian packaged-food manufacturer's shipments to the Philippines--its largest export market--are likely to be weighed by soft purchasing power and intense competition, the analysts say. Philippine demand is shifting toward instant soluble coffee, as instant coffee is cheaper than 3-in-1 coffee, the segment where Mayora is a leading player, they say. While Mayora has an instant soluble coffee product, it is more expensive than established competitors', they say. The analysts cut their 2026-2028 earnings-per-share forecasts by 2.3%-9.6%. CGSI downgrades the stock to hold from add and lowers its target price to 1,540 rupiah from 2,170 rupiah. Shares fall 2.0% to 1,470 rupiah.(megan.cheah@wsj.com)
